lineStatuses.reason: Jubilee Line: No service between Wembley Park and Willesden Green for the rest of the day and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line while emergency services respond to a large fire near the railway at Neasden. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses, DLR, Elizabeth line, Mildmay line, C2C and Thameslink services. If you're travelling to/from Wembley Arena, use the Bakerloo line or Lioness line to Wembley Central station.

lineStatuses.reason: Metropolitan and Jubilee lines: emergency services continue to deal with a large fire in a recycling plant near the railway at Neasden. Until this is made safe, Metropolitan line and Jubilee line services will not run through the area. We do not expect services to resume fully until lunch time on Sunday 30 August 2026 at the earliest. Please check before you travel.

lineStatuses.reason: NORTHERN LINE: Saturday 29 August, from 0330 (including Night Tube), and all day Sunday 30 and Bank Holiday Monday 31 August, no service between Archway and High Barnet / Mill Hill East. Use London Buses route 382 between Finchley Central and Mill Hill East and Night Bus N20 between Archway and High Barnet during Night Tube hours.
